title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Food and Drug Disputes

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where a consumer brings a civil action due to a dispute over food or drugs, and the conditions for acceptance prescribed by the Civil Procedure Law are satisfied, the People's Court shall accept the case.

Article 2 Where damage is caused to a consumer due to quality problems in food or drugs, the consumer may separately sue or simultaneously sue the seller and the producer.
Where the consumer only sues the seller or the producer, the People's Court may, when necessary, add relevant parties to participate in the proceedings.

Article 3 Where a dispute arises over quality problems in food or drugs, and the purchaser asserts rights against the producer or seller, and the producer or seller defends on the ground that the purchaser knowingly purchased the food or drugs despite the quality problems, the People's Court shall not support such defense.

Article 4 Where a free gift of food or drugs provided by a producer or seller to a consumer has quality safety problems, causing damage to the consumer, and the consumer asserts rights, and the producer or seller raises a defense for exemption on the ground that the consumer did not pay consideration for the free gift, the People's Court shall not support such defense.

Article 5 Where a consumer adduces evidence to prove the fact of purchasing the food or drugs and that the purchased food or drugs did not conform to the contract, and asserts that the producer or seller of the food or drugs bears liability for breach of contract, the People's Court shall support it.
Where a consumer adduces evidence to prove that he or she suffered damage from consuming the food or using the drugs, and preliminarily proves that there is a causal relationship between the damage and the consumption of the food or use of the drugs, and requests that the producer or seller of the food or drugs bear tort liability, the People's Court shall support it, unless the producer or seller of the food or drugs can prove that the damage was not caused by the products' failure to conform to quality standards.

Article 6 The producer and seller of food shall bear the burden of adducing evidence that the food conforms to quality standards. Whether food is safe shall be determined on the basis of national standards; for local specialty foods, where there are no national standards, on the basis of local standards; and where none of the aforementioned standards exists, on the basis of the relevant provisions of the Food Safety Law.

Article 7 Where food or drugs have obtained a certificate of inspection qualification before sale and are still within their shelf life at the time of consumption or use, but the products are confirmed to be non-conforming upon inspection, and the producer or seller defends on the ground that the food or drugs have the certificate of inspection qualification, the People's Court shall not support such defense.

Article 8 Where the sponsor of a centralized trading market, the lessor of counters, or the organizer of an exhibition or sale fails to perform the obligations of review, inspection, reporting, and other obligations prescribed by the Food Safety Law, thereby harming the legitimate rights and interests of consumers, and a consumer requests that the sponsor of the centralized trading market, the lessor of counters, or the organizer of the exhibition or sale bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall support it.

Article 9 Where a consumer suffers damage from purchasing food or drugs through a third-party platform for online transactions, and the provider of the third-party platform for online transactions cannot provide the true name, address, and effective contact information of the producer or seller of the food or drugs, and the consumer requests that the provider bear liability, the People's Court shall support it.
Where the provider of the third-party platform for online transactions, after bearing compensation liability, exercises the right of recourse against the producer or seller, the People's Court shall support it.
Where the provider of the third-party platform for online transactions knows or should know that the producer or seller of food or drugs uses its platform to infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of consumers, and fails to take necessary measures, causing damage to consumers, and a consumer requests that it bear joint and several liability with the producer and seller, the People's Court shall support it.

Article 10 Where a civil subject that has not obtained food production qualification and sales qualification produces and sells food by affiliating with a producer and seller with corresponding qualifications, causing damage to a consumer, and the consumer requests that the affiliating party and the affiliated party bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall support it.
Where the consumer only sues the affiliating party or the affiliated party, the People's Court may, when necessary, add relevant parties to participate in the proceedings.

Article 11 Where a consumer suffers damage because food or drugs recommended by false advertising have quality problems, and the consumer, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests and other laws, requests that the advertising operator and advertising publisher bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall support it.
Where other civil subjects recommend food or drugs to consumers in false advertising, causing damage to consumers, and consumers, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Law on the Protection of Consumer Rights and Interests and other laws, request that they bear joint and several liability together with the producer and seller of the food or drugs, the People's Court shall support it.

Article 12 Where a food inspection institution intentionally issues a false inspection report, causing damage to a consumer, and the consumer requests that it bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall support it.
Where a food inspection institution issues an inaccurate inspection report due to negligence, causing damage to a consumer, and the consumer requests that it bear corresponding liability, the People's Court shall support it.

Article 13 Where a food certification institution intentionally issues false certification, causing damage to a consumer, and the consumer requests that it bear joint and several liability, the People's Court shall support it.
Where a food certification institution issues inaccurate certification due to negligence, causing damage to a consumer, and the consumer requests that it bear corresponding liability, the People's Court shall support it.

Article 14 Where food or drugs produced or sold have quality problems, and the producer and seller need to bear civil liability, administrative liability, and criminal liability at the same time, and their property is insufficient to pay, and the party, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Civil Code and other laws, requests that the producer and seller of the food or drugs bear civil liability first, the People's Court shall support it.

Article 15 Where a consumer, in addition to claiming compensation for losses, claims damages from the producer or seller in accordance with the Food Safety Law and other legal provisions because food that does not meet safety standards is produced, or food that is known not to meet safety standards is sold, the People's Court shall support it.
Where a person produces counterfeit drugs or substandard drugs, or knowingly sells or uses counterfeit drugs or substandard drugs, and the victim or his or her close relatives, in addition to claiming compensation for losses, claim damages from the producer or seller in accordance with the Drug Administration Law and other legal provisions, the People's Court shall support it.

Article 16 Where a producer or seller of food or drugs, by means of a standard-form contract, notice, statement, public notice, or other means, makes provisions that exclude or restrict consumers' rights, reduce or exempt the operator's liability, increase consumers' liability, or otherwise are unfair or unreasonable to consumers, and the consumer, according to law, requests that such content be determined void, the People's Court shall support it.

Article 17 Disputes between consumers and entities such as producers, sellers, advertising operators, advertising publishers, recommenders, and inspection institutions with regard to products such as cosmetics and health food shall be handled by reference to these Provisions.
Where organs and relevant organizations prescribed by law initiate public interest litigation according to law, these Provisions shall be applied by reference.

Article 18 For the purposes of these Provisions, "producer of drugs" includes the drug marketing authorization holder and drug manufacturing enterprises, and "seller of drugs" includes drug trading enterprises and medical institutions.

Article 19 These Provisions shall apply to cases of first instance and second instance that are pending before the People's Courts after these Provisions come into force.
These Provisions shall not apply to cases that have become final before these Provisions come into force, and for which, after these Provisions come into force, a party applies for retrial or a retrial is decided in accordance with the trial supervision procedure.
